verdict: The image has a correct Maxwell core and a suggestive knot, but its added labels do not establish a new group or dynamics. The rigorous frontier is the gauge-and-Hodge reconstruction problem: curvature plus gauge, boundary and period data, with helicity as a conditional topological observable.
